# BTC2G

> BTC2G is a free multilingual educational research site for comparing Bitcoin with gold using published daily reference data.

## Public tools and research

- [Bitcoin-to-gold dashboard](https://btc2g.com/): Historical ratio, purchasing-power comparison, reference calculator, disclosed market dates, and model context.
- [What-if scenario simulator](https://btc2g.com/scenario.html): Arithmetic BTC and gold price-change scenarios; not predictions or return promises.
- [SAVE quote comparison](https://btc2g.com/save.html): A private, manual comparison of provider quotes. BTC2G does not process purchases.
- [TimeT research](https://btc2g.com/research.html): Public research documents and explanations.
- [About BTC2G](https://btc2g.com/about.html): Data sources, methodology, and limitations.
- [Support](https://btc2g.com/support.html): Help with accounts, privacy requests, security reports, and feedback.

## Important limitations

- BTC2G provides educational information, not investment, financial, trading, tax, legal, or accounting advice.
- Market data may be delayed, incomplete, unavailable, or corrected. Forecasts and simulations are scenarios, not guaranteed future results.
- BTC2G does not custody funds or crypto assets, execute trades, or store payment-card details. External provider terms and availability apply.
- Premium is in development. The community contest is in preparation; submissions and voting are not open.

## Languages

The dashboard, SAVE comparison, scenario simulator, and Premium information have server-rendered pages in 19 languages: English, Russian, Hebrew, German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, Ukrainian, Indonesian, and Vietnamese.

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://btc2g.com/terms.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://btc2g.com/privacy.html)

The canonical public URL inventory is [sitemap.xml](https://btc2g.com/sitemap.xml). Search or AI inclusion is not guaranteed.
